title: PARDUS SUPER AL 105 — NOW LAUNCHED!

takeaways.text: He walks through a full assembly as a guide for shops and says the shop pre-assembles bikes for customers on request.
Launched in India at about ₹89,000 with Shimano 105 11-speed mechanical shifting, mechanical disc brakes and 28 mm tires from a lesser-known brand; packaging was very protective.
Cost savings include a Prowheel 50/34 crank instead of 105 chainrings, a Selle Royal-group saddle and basic pedals; the extra-small size came with a 380 mm bar.

disclosure: An Indian bike studio that sells and pre-assembles the bike; the Indian launch build uses Shimano 105 R7000 11-speed with mechanical discs rather than the candidate's L-TWOO R9 hydraulic build. Tamil automatic captions.
summary: An Indian shop's unboxing and assembly of the PARDUS Super AL alloy endurance bike at its Indian launch.
